description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Method_UnloadFilter' which extends 'Smarty_Internal_Method_LoadFilter'. The class provides a method to unload a filter by type and name from the Smarty template engine, removing the registered filter from internal storage.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnloadFilter
classes.description: A class that unloads a filter of specified type and name from Smarty's registered filters.

methods.name: unloadFilter
methods.description: Removes a specific filter from the registered filters of the Smarty object, based on type and name.
